question: brief 已确认：无线耳机 LUMO，30 秒横版，受众是每天通勤的年轻上班族，核心信息是“一戴上，世界就安静了”。写脚本。
ground_truth: The agent names one structure and writes exactly six 5-second beats, each with job, see, vo, zh and text. Every vo is one English line of 4-13 words (ideally 6-10) in crafted broadcast copy with no stock ad-speak (no seamless, immerse yourself, like never before) and no absolute claim (no best, perfect, ultimate); the lines vary in length and build to a turn. Every zh is a natural Chinese translation of its line, at most 16 characters, with spaces instead of commas and full stops; every text is a Chinese title of at most 8 characters with no closing punctuation. No switch, keycap or key-travel vocabulary appears. The script is saved to script/script.json and handed to ad-compliance-review before any generation.

ground_truth: The agent explains that clips are generated in 5 s segments so a 15 s film has exactly three beats, and proposes either three beats or a longer duration (up to the 30 s master of six beats) instead of writing eight.

question: brief 已确认：汽油 GT 跑车 VORSA，30 秒横版，受众是 35 岁以上的成功人士，核心信息是“为长路而生”，卖点依据：3.0T 直列六缸。用户原话的定版字幕：“VORSA，为长路而生。” 写脚本。
ground_truth: Six beats in a restrained premium register about the drive felt (the road, the sound, the long stretch ahead). No English absolute claim (the best, ultimate, unbeatable, number one, the only) and no Chinese one (最, 第一, 顶级, 极致). The only figure used is the proof point (3.0T straight six), and no speed or safety promise appears. No title, subtitle or vo repeats the closing line; the last beat hands over to the end card that shows it verbatim.
